bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
WT="$ROOT/.worktrees/tumblr-bridge-live-20261114"
test "$(git -C "$WT" rev-parse HEAD)" = "2ab0cea0b720e5d7c8e3cd231b8018e2362419f1"
test -f "$HOME/.config/tgtumbler/bridge/owner-token"
test -f "$WT/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml"
OUT="$WT/.runtime-build"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
if test -x "$HOME/.local/bin/gh"; then GH="$HOME/.local/bin/gh"; else GH="$(command -v gh)"; fi
"$GH" run download 43506478658 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --name gaybbs-tumblr-bridge-bundle --dir "$OUT"
test -s "$OUT/gaybbs.mjs"
cat > "$OUT/Dockerfile" <<'EOF'
FROM gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
COPY --chown=node:node gaybbs.mjs /app/gaybbs.mjs
EOF
docker build --pull=false -f "$OUT/Dockerfile" -t gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:tumblr-bridge-candidate "$OUT" >/dev/null
docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint node gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:tumblr-bridge-candidate --check /app/gaybbs.mjs
docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:tumblr-bridge-candidate >/dev/null
printf 'BRIDGE_CANDIDATE_READY=YES\n'
